preconditions.description: The value of n must be between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.
The value of m must be between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for x in range(1, n+1) for y in range(1, m+1) if (x + y) % 5 == 0)
postconditions.description: The output must be the count of pairs (x, y) such that 1 ≤ x ≤ n, 1 ≤ y ≤ m, and (x + y) is divisible by 5.
